profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer @ Microsoft
profile.summary: Full-stack engineer and technical leader specializing in AI-focused products, LLM integrations, and large-scale enterprise applications. Proven ability to define architecture and ship durable solutions in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. TS/SCI eligible (T5R completed 12/2020; reinstatement required).

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Define agentic engineering strategy and core architecture for Azure Compute UX, driving consistency and quality across experiences while championing responsible AI practices and compliance standards
• Own the Compute Plugins C#/.NET service, enabling LLM-powered agentic capabilities across Compute with OpenAI and Azure AI services
• Build Skills for GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, and Azure Copilot, enabling natural-language recommendations and actions across Compute resources
• Ship templates, sample plugins, and documentation to accelerate agentic development across the organization
• Collaborate with the Azure Copilot Framework team and cross-functional partners in engineering, PM, and design to deliver platform features and align AI initiatives with product strategy

positions.title: Principal Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
• Led the Azure Arc Private Cloud team of 6 engineers to deliver general availability of Azure Local, SCVMM, and VMware on schedule through close collaboration with partner teams
• Drove the UX implementation of a unified resource model across all VM providers, requiring reassessment and realignment of a year's worth of engineering work across multiple teams
• Enabled large-scale adoption of Azure Arc, supporting tens of thousands of Arc-enabled VMs and extensions across enterprise environments

positions.title: Manager
positions.description:
• Led a team of 8 developers across 3 product delivery groups, providing technical direction and mentorship
• Designed a federated GraphQL API integrating data warehouses and legacy REST services, and guided distributed system design on OpenShift and AWS
• Shipped a greenfield analytics application (React, TypeScript, Mapbox GL) that became the reference architecture for future client applications
• Supported development on 14 applications built with JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, React, Redux, and
Mapbox GL
• Standardized tech stacks and development patterns, improved cross-team communication, and represented engineering in client demos and technical discussions
• Responsible for onboarding and mentoring new developers

positions.title: Geospatial Technologist
positions.description:
• Provided geospatial technology and development support to the Geospatial Research, Analysis, and Services Program at the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
• Built client solutions with ArcGIS Enterprise tools, React, and Redux

positions.title: Geospatial Programmer
positions.description: • Automated the collection and validation of U.S. Census data with ETL processes built with JavaScript

positions.title: Geospatial Intelligence Chief
positions.locationName: 3rd Marine Logistics Group Headquarters G-2, Okinawa, Japan
positions.description:
• Provided geospatial intelligence support to the Commanding General of 3rd Marine Logistics Group, in addition to the twelve subordinate units that belong to the group
• Managed the planning, production, and dissemination of over 500 geospatial products—a tenfold increase over the previous period
• Established a digital library to organize nearly 600 gigabytes of geospatial data, drastically reducing time spent on product production and maintenance
• Coordinated with a third-party contractor to implement a networked server solution, streamlining the G-2’s infrastructure and enabling faster data sharing between teams
• Built custom geoprocessing models and Python scripts to automate tasks and perform ETL operations, improving both data intake and production speeds
• Implemented standard operating procedures and quality controls to facilitate faster daily production
• Led teams conducting annual training exercises and real-world operations spanning multiple countries
• Awarded the Navy and Marine Corps Commendation Medal for work done streamlining the data infrastructure and increasing fusion between the different intelligence sections
• Nominated for the Military Member of the Quarter award through the National System for Geospatial-Intelligence Awards Program

positions.title: Geospatial Intelligence Analyst
positions.description:
• Collected, analyzed, and processed geospatial data to aid in the production of intelligence products
• Produced intelligence products in support of the III Marine Expeditionary Force and the 36 countries that fall under its area of responsibility, utilizing the ArcGIS toolset and Python
• Worked with multiple service branches, civilian intelligence agencies, and multinational partners as part of regular operational duties, training exercises, and real-world operations
• Created a specialized GIS training program for Army intelligence analysts while attached to the 1st Special Forces Group
• Meritoriously promoted in June of 2013

positions.title: Geospatial Intelligence Student
positions.description: • Completed over 820 hours of study in geodetic surveying and geospatial analysis at the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency

positions.title: Freelance Developer
positions.description:
• Explored potential web interfaces for a startup, from design to basic implementation
• Worked with e-commerce customers to improve existing backend systems written in PHP

positions.title: Associate IT Analyst
positions.description:
• Connected internal customers and developers by translating business needs into technical requirements
• Coordinated cross-functional teams and vendors to plan and execute projects
• Managed a software portfolio of more than a dozen applications, including several in-house solutions developed with C# and ASP.NET

educations.schoolName: Virginia Tech - Pamplin College of Business

volunteerExperiences.role: Mentor for the GIS Professional Programs
